title: Fox Street Crossing
description: Hop across busy roads, rapid rivers, and high-speed train tracks as a cute chibi fox! Collect juicy red apples, sparkling starberries, and golden coins while dodging traffic and floating across logs. Unlock awesome fox skins in this endless arcade street crossing adventure!
howToPlay: Desktop: Use WASD, Arrow Keys, or Space to hop forward and change lanes. Mobile: Swipe in any direction or Tap to hop forward. Avoid cars, trucks, and trains. Jump on floating logs to cross rivers without falling into the water. Keep moving forward before the eagle catches you!
